desc:
Welcome to My Anime Card Tycoon! 💪

[HOW TO PLAY]
1. Buy Anime Packs and open to get Cards 🎁
2. Collect Cash earnt by your Anime Cards!💸
3. Upgrade Your Tycoon with Gem Upgrades 💎
4. Become the richest and flex your Collection!🤑

Assemble your base of RARE Anime Cards! 🥊
Earn Cash and Upgrade your base! 💸
Rebirth and Unlock better packs with RARE Cards! 😤

Check back everyday to see how much you've earnt, your cards will earn cash OFFLINE!
Show your support with a Like & Favourite!

⭐ Join the group for a free card, and to stay notified for updates! 
⚠️ Game is new, so bugs are expected! You can report them in Community Forum!
